# MASTER AUDIT — TONBANKCARD Protocol

## Objective

Perform a full, system-wide audit of TONBANKCARD across:

- Architecture
- Smart contracts
- Security
- Economics
- Governance
- Documentation
- Infrastructure
- Integrations

The goal is to identify:

- Missing components
- Inconsistencies
- Unverified assumptions
- Production gaps

---

## Scope

### 1. Architecture Audit
- Verify alignment with Architecture Baseline
- Check trust boundaries
- Validate non-custodial guarantees

---

### 2. Smart Contract Audit
- Code correctness
- State machine integrity
- Access control
- Invariant enforcement

---

### 3. Security Audit
- Threat model completeness
- Key management
- Incident response
- Attack surface coverage

---

### 4. Economic Audit
- Incentive alignment
- Fee sustainability
- Liquidity assumptions
- Attack scenarios

---

### 5. Governance Audit
- DAO constraints
- NFT distribution risk
- Proposal system integrity

---

### 6. Integration Audit
- External providers
- Merchant flows
- API trust boundaries

---

### 7. Infrastructure Audit
- Indexer correctness
- API statelessness
- Failure modes

---

### 8. Documentation Audit
- Consistency
- Completeness
- No contradictions

---

## Deliverable

```
docs/audit/FULL_SYSTEM_AUDIT.md
```

---

## Acceptance Criteria

- All layers audited
- All gaps documented
- All risks classified
- No undefined areas remain
